description: This file appears to be a markdown documentation file for FastAPI's file upload mechanisms, explaining the usage of `File`, `UploadFile`, multipart and form data, and related topics.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data to an UploadFile's internal file.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data from an UploadFile's internal file.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Asynchronously moves the internal pointer of an UploadFile's internal file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the internal file associated with an UploadFile.
